name: Alther's Mill
summary: Lucius sends Alliance rogues to test their skill at Alther's Mill. It lies northeast along the road from Lakeshire, where Blackrock orcs now draw near.

sections.title: A Test of Grace and Finesse
sections.body: Lucius sends you northeast from Lakeshire along the road to Alther's Mill, carrying your first set of thieves' tools. There, a locked chest puts your skill to the test. Open Lucius's personal lockbox and bring back the token inside to earn your Certificate of Thievery.

sections.title: Shadows Around the Saws
sections.body: Alther's Mill once served as a lumber outpost. Now Blackrock orcs press into Redridge and have drawn near, so Lucius makes their presence part of the trial. SI:7 expects its agents to pick locks unseen while moving through enemy-held ground.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the mission to Alther's Mill?
faq.answer: Lucius tests your lockpicking in the field. He gives you thieves' tools and asks you to retrieve a token from a locked chest as proof of your skill.
Lucius trains rogues in Lakeshire, in the Redridge Mountains. He schools recruits sent by contacts across the Alliance, testing their stealth and manual skill.

aliases: how do i find althers mill
faq.answer: Alther's Mill lies just off the road northeast and east of Lakeshire, against the foothills before the higher mountain passes.

faq.q: Why are there orcs around Alther's Mill?
faq.answer: Blackrock clan orcs have come down from Stonewatch and the burning ridges above. They raid human settlements and establish forward footholds throughout Redridge, including around the abandoned mill.

faq.q: What reward does Lucius grant upon completing the task?
faq.answer: Lucius awards you the Certificate of Thievery. It recognizes your grasp of tumblers and lockpicks and your readiness to serve as a certified field rogue.

faq.q: How does this quest fit into rogue training across the Alliance?
faq.answer: Rogues across Alliance lands are directed by contacts such as Mathias Shaw's SI:7 handlers in Stormwind to meet Lucius in Lakeshire. The test at Alther's Mill is the final practical trial in their basic field training.

angles.text: As a rogue, you receive your lockpicking tools and field credentials while testing your patience and stealth near Blackrock orcs.
As an Alliance member, you help train thieves and infiltrators near Lakeshire while watching Blackrock movements.
